alm_about_intro: Everything here is computed on this device, offline. How close each figure is:
alm_about_moon: Moon: phase, distance and illumination within about 0.1% of reference ephemerides.
alm_about_seasons: Equinoxes and solstices: within about a minute of USNO times.
alm_about_sun: Sunrise and sunset: usually within a minute or two, less exact near the poles.
alm_about_eclipses: Eclipses: dates and types, not local circumstances.
alm_about_tides: Tides: from tide gauges' harmonic constants, NOAA's in the United States (public domain) and TICON-3's elsewhere (Hart-Davis, Dettmering and Seitz 2022, CC BY 4.0), the gauges named from GeoNames (CC BY 4.0); usually within about ten minutes and twenty centimetres. None is shown where no gauge is near.
alm_about_planets: Planets: good to a fraction of a degree for a few centuries around today.
alm_about_islamic: Islamic calendar: arithmetic; may differ by a day or two from one based on sighting the moon.
alm_about_chinese: Chinese calendar: matches the Hong Kong Observatory from 1900 to 2100.
alm_about_deeptime: Deep time: within 13,000 years of 2000 the methods hold; beyond that, out to 270,000 years, figures are indicative only.
alm_about_timezones: Time zones: the nearest of a set of cities, since there is no offline map of zone borders; may be off near a border.

voices_test_reading: Water boils at about 100 °C (212 °F) at sea level, but at only about 90 °C at 3,000 m, so food takes longer to cook in the mountains. Keep the pot covered: a lid saves fuel and brings the water back to the boil sooner. Rice, beans and pasta (e.g. spaghetti) need a few more minutes for every 300 m above the sea, so taste them before you serve. On Mount Everest, at 8,849 m, water boils at roughly 70 °C, too cool for a good cup of tea.

setup_password_desc: Anyone on your network can manage Zimi.
setup_open_cost: Anyone who can reach this address will be able to download and delete ZIMs and change any setting, even lock you out. Your password is kept in case you turn it back on.
setup_open_cost_new: Anyone who can reach this address will be able to download and delete ZIMs and change any setting, even lock you out.
setup_password_desc_anywhere: Anyone who can reach this address can manage Zimi.
setup_key_hint: Printed in the server's log when Zimi started. It shows this is your server.
setup_bad_key: That setup key didn't work. Check the server's log.
setup_waiting_body: It opens once its owner finishes setting it up.
outside_locked_body: Zimi can only be managed from the network it is on.
open_locked: Not while anyone can manage Zimi. Turn the password back on first.
desktop_share_body: Zimi can stay on this computer, or open to phones and computers on the same network.
create_cookies_note: Sent only to this site, and never saved.
look_denied: Motion is off. Drag to look around.
look_none: This device has no motion sensors. Drag to look around.
look_calibrate: Wave the phone in a figure eight to settle the compass.
look_no_north: This phone cannot find north, so the view may be turned.
look_insecure: Motion sensors require an HTTPS connection. Drag to look around.
fieldguide_disclaimer: Not medical advice. Call emergency services if you can.
fieldguide_english_only: The sources are shown in English.
fieldguide_library_note: The sources behind each situation, and how large they are.
fieldguide_needs_admin: Sign in as an administrator to add ZIMs.
fieldguide_failed: That did not work. Try again.
lib_folders_hint: Zimi accesses ZIMs in these folders read-only.
net_nomad_when: Its admin on this network, only when Project NOMAD mode is on
nomad_mode_desc: Off, Zimi only reads NOMAD's ZIMs. On, Download, Update and Delete in Zimi ask NOMAD to do the work, so NOMAD's own library, Kiwix, updates and assistant stay in step.
nomad_mode_why_unreachable: NOMAD's API did not answer, so Zimi stays read-only. Type its address below if it is not found on its own.
nomad_mode_why_version: NOMAD {version} is not a version Zimi knows ({supported}x), so Zimi stays read-only.
nomad_mode_why_shape: NOMAD answered in a way Zimi does not expect, so Zimi stays read-only.
nomad_mode_why_no_folder: No Project NOMAD folder has been added, so there is nothing to manage.
nomad_bad_url: That is not a web address (http:// or https://).
folder_not_ours: {label} looks after this file. Remove or update it there.
folder_missing: That folder does not exist, or cannot be seen from here.
folder_is_library: That is Zimi's own library folder.
folder_env: Set by ZIMI_EXTRA_ZIM_DIRS. Change it where Zimi is started.
folder_unknown: That folder is not in the list.
folder_primary_only: Only the primary admin can name a folder on the server.
ext_folder_empty_hint: Download content there and it shows up here in about a minute.
lib_folders_shadowed: {n} not shown: same name as one of Zimi's. Zimi's copy wins.
zim_unreadable_permission: Can't open: Zimi has no permission to read it
zim_unreadable_corrupt: Can't open: the file looks damaged or is still arriving
keep_install_note: Add Zimi to your Home Screen first. Safari clears a website's files after a week unused; an installed app keeps them.
keep_unsupported: This browser cannot keep files on the device.
keep_not_in_copy: This page is not in the copy of this ZIM on this device.
keep_no_room: Not enough room on this phone.
keep_stay_open: Keep Zimi open and the screen on while this runs. If it stops, Resume picks up where it left off.
keep_persist_no: Not protected: if the phone runs low on space it may clear this.
keep_one_at_a_time: Another ZIM is downloading. One at a time.
keep_err_auth: Sign in to keep this ZIM on your phone.
keep_err_gone: This ZIM is no longer on the server.
keep_err_xz: This ZIM uses an older compression (xz) that the phone reader cannot open yet.
keep_err_unsupported: This ZIM uses a compression the phone reader cannot open yet.
keep_err_quota: The phone is full. Free up space and Resume.
keep_err_network: The connection dropped. Resume when you are back online.
keep_err_locked: Another copy of this download is still running. Close other Zimi windows and try again.
keep_err_storage: This browser will not let Zimi store files here (Private Browsing, or website data turned off).
keep_err_corrupt: The download did not arrive intact and was removed. Try again.
keep_err_worker: Could not start the download on this phone.
offline_works_kept_desc: {size} on this phone. Read and search with no signal
keep_search_warming: Titles on this phone, now. Full-text search is starting and will add to this.
keep_search_titles: Titles on this phone. Full-text search could not start here.
keep_search_full: From the ZIMs on this phone: titles first, then full text.
keep_signout_note: Signing out removes it from this phone: it was kept under your account.
keep_big: This takes a big share of the room left on this phone. Keep it offline anyway?
keep_not_here: Not on this phone. Keep it offline while you're connected.
offline_none_hint: Nothing kept yet. Choose Keep offline on a ZIM while you're connected and it opens here with no signal.
conn_pill_nonet_hint: Showing what's on this phone. Zimi reconnects by itself.
conn_pill_server_hint: Your Zimi server isn't answering. Showing what's on this phone.
conn_pill_error_hint: Some things could not be refreshed. Showing what's on this phone.
keep_from_files_note: Copied from Files. It lives on this phone and needs no server.
keep_err_notzim: That file is not a ZIM.
keep_toobig_title: Too big for this phone's Zimi space
keep_toobig_guess: The phone's figure is a rough estimate. You can try anyway: it stops cleanly if the phone says no.
near_pick_nearest: {place} at {where}: of {n} places with that name, the nearest to you.
near_pick_largest: {place} at {where}: of {n} places with that name, the largest.
near_not_found: No installed map names a place called {place}.
games_sync_merged: Your games on this device and in your account are together now.
display_name_hint: How you appear in games and on this server's leaderboards. Leave it empty to use your account name.
display_name_taken: Someone on this server already goes by that name.
display_name_invalid: Use up to 32 letters, numbers, spaces, dots or dashes.
net_addons_when: Browser, SingleFile, video and import tools, once, when added
pdf_failed_body: The file is missing or damaged. The rest of the collection is fine.
map_newer: A newer {map} is in the Catalog
map_none_here: No map of here to open or download
cap_hint_auto: Chosen for this device, and lowered if frames run slow
cap_hint_full: Every effect, as sharp as this screen allows
cap_level_low: This device runs the light version
cap_level_standard: This device runs the standard version
cap_level_high: This device runs the full version
cap_static: The 3D view is off on this device.
pdf_too_large: This PDF is too large to open here: it is stored compressed in its ZIM.
app_about_tube: Talks, lectures and channels from your library, played from files on this device. No connection needed.
app_about_exchange: Questions and answers from Q&A sites such as Stack Overflow, kept in your library. Browse by tag or search.
app_about_reddot: Subreddits kept as ZIM files: the posts and their comment threads, readable offline.
app_about_wiki: Wikipedias and other wikis from your library, with the day’s picks and On this day.
app_about_books: Every book in your library on one shelf. Browse by author, subject, era or language.
app_about_dictionary: One word, looked up in every Wiktionary in your library.
app_about_games: Over 100 games that run from your library: puzzles, boards, cards and city building.
app_about_almanac: The sky, Earth and calendars, worked out on this device. No connection needed.
app_about_maps: Offline maps from your library. Search places and find the way; nothing is sent anywhere.
app_about_fieldguide: Twenty-five situations answered in cited quotes from your library, for a bad day with no signal.
sent_ghost: A faint stand-in near its last known place, not tracked
voices_cache_desc: Said words and sentences are kept so they play at once. Off keeps them in memory only and writes nothing to the data folder.
cat_community_desc: Contributed by users to the Kiwix catalog
backup_merge_ask: Merge this with what is here, or replace it? Replacing cannot be undone.
older_copies_hint: Files an update replaced. They stay until you remove them, in case the new one is worse.
addon_why_offline: Zimi is offline, so it cannot be added
addon_why_unsupported: this install does not add it
addon_why_never: Get add-ons is set to Never
offline_ready_hint: What needs a download before Zimi works fully with no internet.
offline_ready_offline: Zimi is offline, so what is missing cannot be fetched until it is online.
offline_some_failed: {n} could not be fetched. Try again.
offline_d_almanac_hd: Sharp Earth, Moon and planet tiles
offline_d_voices: A natural voice for reading aloud
offline_d_maps: A map of your area, to find your way offline
config_not_kept: This container's /config isn't kept: settings and add-ons go when it is replaced. Mount a volume at /config.
debuglog_desc: Records taps and errors from every window into a rolling file on the server.
